_comment: IFR approach — LFMN RNP 04LA with visual last segment. Approach track (353 deg) is ~47 degrees off runway heading (040 deg): pilot cannot report 'established' on the instrument procedure and instead reports 'runway in sight' for a visual approach to the runway. Approach-only scenario starting at IFR/APPROACH_TOWER (Approach has issued 'contact Tower, runway in sight'). Verifies that 'runway in sight' parses as INITIAL_CALL_TOWER and produces a landing clearance — the same IFR/APPROACH_TOWER template handles both ILS and visual last-segment arrivals. LFMN APP 120.025 / TWR 118.700 / GND 121.750.
name: IFR approach — LFMN RNP 04LA visual last segment

say.note: 0 — Approach issued 'contact Tower, runway in sight' (47 deg track divergence: visual segment mandatory). Jump to IFR/APPROACH_TOWER.
1 — Pilot reports runway in sight. Expect landing clearance (INITIAL_CALL_TOWER -> cleared to land). Heading 353 confirms visual approach, not ILS established.
say.text: Nice Tower Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta established visual runway zero four left

say.note: 2 — Runway vacated. Regular airport: expect 'contact Ground on 121.750, good day'.
say.text: Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta runway vacated
